title: How to write and test a Suno prompt
reported_observation: Guide proposes separating prompts into musical lane, motion, sound sources, voice/lead and production space, then testing one phrase at a time.
creator_interpretation: Provides a useful conventional baseline for controlled prompting and a checklist of audible dimensions.
our_hypothesis: A layered taxonomy could provide control dimensions, while our experiments test whether cross-domain and invented terms can manipulate those dimensions indirectly.
